mentions.name: PenPage
mentions.description: A lightweight, privacy-first markdown editor that stores everything locally in the browser (IndexedDB). It requires no signup, works offline as an app, and optionally syncs to Google Drive.
mentions.problem: Heavier note-taking tools like Obsidian add overhead when you just want to take quick notes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on PenPage (https://penpage.com) - it's a lightweight privacy-first markdown editor that stores everything locally in your browser local DB (IndexedDB). No signup required, works offline as a APP, and optionally syncs to Google Drive if needed. Great for quick notes without the overhead of heavier tools like Obsidian.
